4832846.note: Claiborne carried the ball three times for 12 yards during Minnesota's win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

4832955.name: Emmett Johnson
4832955.note: Johnson turned three carries into six yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win over the Chargers. He also returned two kickoffs for 50 yards.

4837248.name: Fernando Mendoza
4837248.note: Mendoza did not play a single snap during the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

4869645.name: Caleb Douglas
4869645.note: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Friday that Douglas (ankle) will play Sunday against the Jets, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

4870612.name: Zachariah Branch
4870612.note: Branch caught both of his targets for nine yards while adding 85 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 31-23 loss to Chicago.

4870653.name: KC Concepcion
4870653.note: Concepcion (calf/quadriceps) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Titans, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

4870808.name: Jeremiyah Love
4870808.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Love (ankle) won't play Sunday against the Broncos, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

4870847.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
4870847.note: Lane brought in four of five targets for 40 yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

4871023.name: Carnell Tate
4871023.note: Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

4876132.name: Josh Cuevas
4876132.note: Cuevas caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 13-10 loss to Cleveland.

4879194.name: Josh Cameron
4879194.note: Cameron didn't garner a target and recorded 46 kickoff-return yards during Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

4879276.name: Bryce Lance
4879276.note: Lance caught two of four passes for nine yards and a touchdown during the Saints' 34-27 win over the Giants on Sunday.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.note: Kacmarek (hamstring) was limited in Thursday's practice, but he said he expects to play Sunday versus the Jets, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

4880281.name: Jordyn Tyson
4880281.note: Saints general manager Mickey Loomis said Tuesday that Tyson (hamstring) is "getting closer" but won't practice this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

4882093.name: Bhayshul Tuten
4882093.note: Tuten carried the ball 12 times for 39 yards and caught all four of his targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

4887558.name: Emanuel Wilson
4887558.note: Wilson will be the lead back for Sunday's game against the Chiefs after Zach Charbonnet (knee) was ruled out ahead of that contest, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

4890973.name: Ashton Jeanty
4890973.note: Jeanty rushed 10 times for 22 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of six targets for 36 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

4912052.name: Justin Joly
4912052.note: Joly (concussion) did not appear on the Dolphins' injury report Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.note: Allen caught both of his passes for 27 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

5081397.name: Dylan Sampson
5081397.note: Sampson (knee) was activated from injured reserve Saturday.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.note: Williams brought in three of four targets for 50 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

5082630.name: Jalen Royals
5082630.note: Royals caught two of his four targets for 24 yards during Kansas City's win over the Chargers on Sunday.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.note: Fannin brought in one of three targets for nine yards in the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.note: Sadiq caught one of three targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.note: Flournoy caught seven of nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.note: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

5093923.name: Andrew Armstrong
5093923.note: The Chiefs signed Armstrong from the practice squad to the active roster Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.note: TeSlaa failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.note: Runyon (foot) was a full participant in practice Wednesday.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.note: Hurst and the other Buccaneers' wide receivers will have elevated roles against the Panthers on Sunday due to the absence of Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot).

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.note: Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.
